messages:
deploybot: PROD deploy started by alex — env=prod region=us-west-2 commit=a1b2c3d4 tag=release/v3.5.7. initiating canary wave 1
alex: Kicking off cutover window, I've pinned traffic schedule and notified oncall.
marie: I will run quick smoke tests on canary-1, watching tail latency and error budget.
jamal: Monitoring metrics + traces. will signal if anything looks off.
deploybot: Canary 1/3 status: HEALTHY (serving 5tps). rolling to canary-2.
ops-bot: Observability quick-check: 95th latency = 78ms, errors = 0.02% over last 2m.
marie: Noticed a small tail latency bump on one pod in canary-2, pausing traffic at 30% while I dig in.
alex: Good catch — hold traffic. rollback criteria stands: errors >0.5% OR sustained 95th > 300ms for 5m triggers abort.
jamal: Agree with hold. Pulling logs from the affected replica now.
sre-oncall: Recreating pod and checking kernel/network metrics, will report back.
marie: Root cause looks like a GC pause in the JVM process on that instance. Restarted the pod, pod is healthy again.
deploybot: Traffic hold engaged by marie — canary at 30% pinned to commit a1b2c3d4.
alex: Thanks. Proceed with cautious ramp after 10m stable window.
deploybot: Resuming traffic — shifting to 60% (canary pass checks).
ops-bot: Post-resume checks: error-rate 0.01%, 95th latency 82ms, request success 99.997% :rocket:
marie: Running the automated smoke suite again: all checks passed.
jamal: Running a quick rerank/throughput sweep against the new runtime, looks within expected bounds.
deploybot: Rolling to 100% gradually — expected full shift in ~6m.
deploybot: PRODUCTION deploy complete. commit=a1b2c3d4 tag=release/v3.5.7 env=prod region=us-west-2 duration=00:12:44. :white_check_mark:
alex: Release notes (short): runtime: bump inference runtime v2 -> v2.1; fix: prefix cache eviction bug; perf: improved batching heuristics. Will publish docs and changelog.
marie: I'll attach the smoke logs and the canary graphs to the release PR.
jamal: If we see any regression in the next 24h we can revert to tag release/v3.5.6 — rollback playbook in ops-runbook.
sre-oncall: Noted. Keeping an eye on alerts, will escalate if any unusual signals.
alex: Closing thread for now — will reopen if any follow-up. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
